name: MAADEN
method: Every file scanned page by page (sha256 recomputed = inventory). Statement pages of the FY2024/FY2025 annual FS are image-only and were rendered and read by eye; 2026 interims are text and were read through the text layer with arithmetic re-added; the six 'scanned_unreadable' files were rendered and are earnings releases. Annual reports 2011-2021 and 2023-2025 integrated reports were classified by page scan only.

dimension_1_value_correctness.verdict: extractable_and_verified for FY2025 (BS/P&L/CF, image pages, arithmetic exact), H1 2026 (BS/P&L/CF, text, exact), Q1 2026 (totals), FY2024 balance sheet (original equals FY2025 comparative); not read for the other 35 files.
verified: H1 2026 (6ae1825e pdf p6/8/11): revenue 19,725,787 and profit 4,069,923 (thousands); Q2 revenue 10,939,233, Q2 profit 2,281,578; total assets 125,720,012; cash 10,079,712; CFO 2,083,447; net change (503,836) reconciles.
FY2024 SOFP original (cbabed5a pdf p13): total assets 115,089,370,018 = FY2025 comparative.
not_read: OCI (p14) and equity (p16) pages of FY2025
P&L and CF of FY2024 original; FY2023/FY2022 statements (183ee2cf, 6e169104 not value-read)
annual reports 2011, 2015-2021, 2023 (front section), 2024, integrated report 2025 (statements inside, not read)
dimension_1_value_correctness.currency_units: ANNUAL statements in FULL Saudi Riyals; INTERIM statements in SAR THOUSANDS. Each document also prints supplementary USD columns at fixed 3.75 which are NOT the reporting currency.
hazards: 1000x unit hazard between annual and interim files.
USD columns beside SAR columns: a column-position parser can read USD as SAR.
Income tax is a credit (+129,138,478 FY2025) while zakat and severance fees are separate charges.
FY2025 cover marked 'Classification: Top Secret' and interims 'Restricted' (metadata of a public filing).
Label 'Proceeds from redemption of time deposits' carries negative values in interim CF (net placement).

dimension_2_document_completeness.verdict: 42 files, all Ma'aden. By page: 18 FS documents (14 interims 2022-2026 + 4 annuals FY2022-FY2025), 11 annual/integrated reports (2011, 2015-2021, 2023-2025), 13 earnings releases/decks (6 of them image-only releases the inventory called 'scanned unreadable'). 4b407f21 is a 6-page SE results announcement containing only a condensed P&L for 2018 (partial, not FS).
dimension_2_document_completeness.label_defects: SE annual FS PDFs labelled with publication year: 183ee2cf '2023|FY' = FY2022; 6e169104 '2024|FY' = FY2023; cbabed5a '2025|FY' = FY2024; d76aaa7c '2026|FY' = FY2025. Annual reports and releases are labelled with the fiscal year, so a single FY label can hold FY(n) report and FY(n-1) statements (2023|FY: 183ee2cf FY2022 statements, c516717e annual report 2023, 90efa3ce FY2023 release). 4 labels are wrong; the 2018 and 2011 files are correct.

dimension_3_company_coverage.verdict: Collected at statement level: every period Q1 2022-H1 2026 (18 of 18) incl. FY2022-FY2025, plus annual reports for FY2011 and FY2015-FY2021. FY2012-FY2014 annuals and all 2011-2021 interims are NOT collected (never targeted, not shown to be unavailable). FY2018-FY2021 statements exist only inside the annual report PDFs (not read).
dimension_3_company_coverage.inventory_correction: Inventory 15 complete/6 partial/1 scanned/30 absent: the 'scanned_only' period (2023 scans) is an earnings release, not a statement; label correction adds FY2022 (in 2023|FY) and removes the apparent 2022|FY gap.

inventory_flag_confirmations: CORRECTED: six 'scanned_unreadable' files are earnings releases (no statements by design).
CONFIRMED: d76aaa7c '2026|FY' period mismatch candidate is a label artefact; its 'detected 2026-02-28' date is the issue date, true period 31 Dec 2025.
CONFIRMED: 'missing cash flows' in cbabed5a is because statements are image pages (pdf p13-18), not because cash flow is absent (not read, expected on image pages 17-18).
CORRECTED: 2025|FY 52e2a2b4 'presentation' = FY2025 results deck, correct label but no statements.
